the co encapsulation efficiency and bioaccessibility of bioactive compounds could be enhanced by adding polysaccharides to the oil water emulsions.

the addition of polysaccharid es can promote the encapsulation of bioactives with different solubilities in the oil water interface, and improve the storage stability and digestive stability of emulsions.

the addition of polysaccharidessuch as pectin or gum Arabic can be used to improve the stability and bio accessibility of bioactives in protein stabilized emulsions.
